# 3 bed detached house for sale

> Castleconnell is a picturesque riverside village on the River Shannon, situated on the Limerick–Clare border and just 15km from Limerick City. Steeped in history, the village takes its name from the Castle of Connell, the ruins of which stand overlooking the Shannon.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 156 m²
- Energetická náročnost: D
- Lokalita: Railway Road, Coolriery, Castleconnell
- Cena: 400 000 €
